svg.title: Complete electrical schematic for underwater hull cleaning robot
svg.desc: Full system-level schematic showing topside 24V/15A power supply through 14 AWG tether to onboard sealed housing containing 4 TB6600 stepper drivers driving 4 NEMA 23 motors via 30R300UPR polyfuses, 1 IBT-4 driver running JGB37-555 DC motor via ATC-5 fuse, 3 ESP32 boards on shared I2C bus with 4.7k pullups, MAX485 RS485 transceiver, 24V to 5V buck converter, and decoupling capacitors on every driver with full voltage and current annotations.
svg.text: Coral = 24V power · Blue = 5V logic · Teal = signals · Purple = drivers · Amber = motors
Tether · 3 m · enters housing through cable gland
STEP / DIR / ENA × 4 (12 GPIOs from ESP32 wheels)
100µF electrolytic + 0.1µF ceramic in parallel across V+/GND of each driver
within 5cm of the chip · 4× on TB6600 24V inputs · 1× on IBT-4 24V input
All GNDs tied common · tether shield grounded topside ONLY · floating at robot end
5 motors · 5 drivers · 3 ESP32 · 2 MAX485 · 6 fuses (5 protection + 1 main) · 2 fuse holders · 4 polyfuses · 2 pullups · 5 cap sets · 1 buck
Topside total ≈ 11.8A peak @ 24V · onboard 5V rail ≈ 1.2A peak
